item.title: Warming shelters to open amid freezing weather in the Wiregrass
item.description: DOTHAN, Ala (WDHN) -- Warming shelters will open early this week as a cold front is expected to hit the Wiregrass Monday night. item.title: National Guard to patrol New Orleans for New Year's a year after deadly attack
item.description: A National Guard deployment in New Orleans authorized by President Donald Trump will begin Tuesday as part of a heavy security presence for New Year’s celebrations a year after an attack on revelers on Bourbon Street killed 14 people, officials said Monday.
